title: Phantom Photographer: City Snapshot Hunt
description: The player controls an antique camera floating above a virtual city and must photograph specific hidden targets scattered across rooftops and alleyways. Each successful snapshot scores points based on framing accuracy and distance, with a timer counting down. The player navigates the camera through the city, adjusts zoom, and captures exactly 6 targets to complete the mission.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a photography hunt game. Load AntiqueCamera.glb and VirtualCity.glb using GLTFLoader. Place the VirtualCity model centered at the origin scaled appropriately to fill the scene. Position the AntiqueCamera model as the player's avatar floating 15 units above the city, visible in third-person view. Create a chase camera that follows behind and above the antique camera model. Generate 6 glowing target markers (small rotating golden rings with PointLight) placed at semi-random positions around the city at varying heights. Display a HUD using HTML overlay showing: current score, targets remaining (out of 6), a 90-second countdown timer, and a circular crosshair reticle in screen center. Player interactions: (1) WASD keys move the antique camera horizontally through the city, (2) Q/E keys adjust altitude up and down with clamped range 5-30 units, (3) mouse movement rotates the camera's facing direction with pointer lock, (4) mouse scroll adjusts a zoom level variable between 1x-3x that scales the crosshair size and affects scoring, (5) left-click fires a raycast from screen center to check if a target is within the reticle, (6) when a target is hit, play a flash effect (white screen overlay fading out over 300ms), remove the target, increment score based on distance (closer gives more points, multiplied by zoom level), and show a floating +score text that fades upward. Validate each capture: the ray must intersect the target's bounding sphere, zoom must be at least 1.5x for bonus points, and the camera must be within 40 units of the target. Add directional light simulating golden hour with warm orange tones, ambient light, and fog with a slight blue tint for depth. When all 6 targets are captured or the timer expires, show a results screen overlay with total score and a restart button. Add subtle camera bob animation during movement for immersion. Ensure collision boundaries prevent the antique camera from going below city rooftop level.
